wiki.title: Anamarie Avila Farias
wiki.extract: Anamarie Ávila Farías is an American politician who is a member of the California State Assembly from the 15th district since 2024. She previously served on the Contra Costa County Board of Education, the California Housing Finance Agency board, and the Martinez City Council.
